title: Sereja and Squares
statementMd:
Sereja has painted $*n*$ distinct points on the plane. The coordinates of each point are integers. Now he is wondering: how many squares are there with sides parallel to the coordinate axes and with points painted in all its four vertexes? Help him, calculate this number.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$. Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$, the integers represent the coordinates of the $*i*$-th point. It is guaranteed that all the given points are distinct.

## Output

In a single line print the required number of squares.
statementZhMd:
Sereja 在平面上绘制了 $*n*$ 个互不相同的点。每个点的坐标都是整数。现在他想知道：有多少个边平行于坐标轴，且四个顶点上都有已绘制点的正方形？请帮助他计算这个数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$，表示第 $*i*$ 个点的坐标。保证所有给出的点互不相同。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出所求正方形的数量。
